map.速动比率剔除存货后的短期偿债能力。: Compute the quick ratio from current assets, inventory and current liabilities to assess short-term solvency excluding inventory.
map.速动比率 = (流动资产−存货)/流动负债: Quick Ratio = (Current Assets − Inventory) / Current Liabilities
map.之外，剔除变现较慢的存货，看即时偿债能力。: , the quick ratio strips out slower-moving inventory to gauge immediate solvency.
map.存货占比高的企业（如零售、地产），速动比率比流动比率更关键。: For companies with a high inventory share (such as retail and real estate), the quick ratio matters more than the current ratio.
map.债权人审核短期头寸时，速动比率是更严苛的底线指标。: When creditors review short-term positions, the quick ratio is the stricter baseline indicator.
map.某公司流动资产 800 万元（其中存货 300 万元）、流动负债 400 万元，: A company has current assets of 800 (10k CNY) (including inventory of 300 (10k CNY)) and current liabilities of 400 (10k CNY), so the quick ratio = (800−300)/400 = 1.25, meaning quick assets excluding inventory still cover 1.25 times short-term liabilities.
map.通常包括货币资金、交易性金融资产、应收账款等可快速变现资产；保守口径还会剔除变现: They usually include cash, trading financial assets, accounts receivable and other assets that convert to cash quickly; a conservative measure also excludes receivables whose collection is uncertain.
map.速动比率一定要≥1 吗？: Must the quick ratio be at least 1?
map.≥1 表示速动资产足以覆盖短期负债，较安全；但强现金流行业（如快消）可低于 1: A ratio of 1 or more means quick assets cover short-term liabilities and is relatively safe; but strong-cash-flow industries such as FMCG can run below 1 without worry, so judge it together with collection speed.
